BHADARWAH CAMPUS
Department of Computer Science & IT
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
WALK-IN INTERVIEW
Candidates are invited for a walk-in-interview for the post of Guest
Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science & IT, Bhaderwah
Campus, University of Jammu. Eligibility will be as per the University
norms. The appointment on the post will be purely on temporary basis
till further orders.
Interested eligible candidates should report at Office of the I/C Head,
Department of Computer Science & IT, Bhaderwah Campus for walk-in-
interview on 11th September 2025 at 10:00 AM with all relevant
educational documents and testimonials in original.
I/C Head
Office Address: Department of Computer Science & IT, Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu
village Sungli Bhaderwah. Pin 182222, Mob: +91-8825081793, e-mail: ashoksharma@jammuuniversity.ac.in
TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. The Guest Lecturer shall be eligible for remuneration as per the
University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits, which are
admissible to the regular employees of University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular
appointment in University of Jammu or for continued services in
the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement
any time in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any
other administrative reasons/ compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute/ ambiguity that may occur in the process
of selection, the decision of the University shall be final.
6.Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In-
Interview on prescribed date and time along with all supporting
documents in original.
